data.name: 6-7 Nights At Vicente's
data.detailed_description: In this game you will be tormented by Vicente's, while playing as Rubevids, you will have to survive 7 nights at his grandfathers house, in this game there are more 50 scenes and 6 enemies, including the custom night, Take control of Detective Rubevids as he investigates the mysterious disappearances in the town of Isla Morcilla, inside the Vicente House. Each night, you must survive until 6:00 a.m., facing criminals, José Vicente himself, and paranormal forces, with new mechanics introduced every night that test your skills. Explore the haunted rooms, uncover the dark secrets of the house, and confront dangers that blur the line between the living and the supernatural.

data.short_description: 6-7 Nights at Vicente’s is a horror and strategy game in the style of Five Nights at Freddy’s. On Morcilla Island, Detective Rubevids investigates Vicente’s house, where he must keep watch, manage resources, and survive threats to uncover the truth before it’s too late.
